room_rent.note: All plan variants: actuals up to Sum Insured; no room category restriction mentioned

icu.note: ICU charges covered at actuals up to Sum Insured across all plan variants

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan; 10%/20% co-pay is an optional add-on (D.3) that once opted cannot be removed. OPD cover has built-in co-pays of 20%/30%/50% for respective sub-sections.

sub_limits.note: Bariatric surgery capped (₹50k–₹2L by plan); Road ambulance ₹3k–₹5k/hosp (Infinite: up to SI); Air ambulance up to ₹2L–₹10L; Maternity sub-limited; AYUSH up to SI; most other covers at actuals up to SI

deductible.note: Aggregate deductible is an optional add-on (D.4): ₹1L/₹2L/₹3L for Prime/Elite/Premier; ₹3L/₹5L for Platinum; ₹5L/₹10L for Infinite

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period; not applicable for accidents; not applicable for hypertension, diabetes, cardiac (90-day specific waiting applies instead)

ped_waiting.note: All plan variants have 24-month PED waiting period; reducible via portability credits

specific_disease_waiting.note: Platinum and Infinite plans: 1 year; Prime, Elite, Premier plans: 2 years for listed specific diseases/procedures

maternity.display: Covered (24mo wait for family; 48mo for single adult)
maternity.note: Inbuilt from Premier plan onwards; NA on Prime and Elite. Premier: ₹25k normal/₹50k C-sec; Platinum: ₹50k/₹75k; Infinite: up to ₹2L. Single adult: 48-month wait + 5 continuous premiums; other family combos: 24-month wait + 3 continuous premiums.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of base SI added per claim-free year; max 100% for Prime/Elite/Premier/Platinum; max 200% for Infinite. Reduces at same rate if claim made. Optional ECB Safeguard add-on protects bonus if claim ≤₹1L.

restoration.note: ReInsure Benefit (C.12): triggered from first claim, unlimited restorations up to 100% of base SI for both related and unrelated illnesses (Prime–Platinum); Infinite: up to 200%. Enhanced ReInsure optional add-on upgrades to 200% for Prime–Platinum.

pre_hosp.note: All plan variants: 60 days pre-hospitalisation expenses covered up to SI

post_hosp.note: Prime/Elite/Premier/Platinum: 90 days; Infinite: 180 days; covered up to SI

day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered across all plan variants up to SI; must be admitted >2 hours

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if condition prevents transfer or no hospital bed available; minimum 3 consecutive days; pre/post-hosp not payable under this benefit

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalisation covered at actuals up to Sum Insured across all plan variants

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI; donor pre/post-hosp excluded; available across all plans

ambulance.note: Prime/Elite: ₹3,000; Premier: ₹4,000; Platinum: ₹5,000; Infinite: up to SI per hospitalisation. Air ambulance also covered (domestic) up to ₹2L–₹10L by plan.

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, HIFU, deep brain stimulation etc. covered at actuals up to SI across all plans

consumables.note: Claims Shield (C.17) makes non-payable consumable items (Annexure II List I) payable when a hospitalisation claim is admitted; inbuilt across all plans up to SI

global_cover.display: Optional (listed major illnesses, diagnosis in India)
global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad (C.24) available on Elite/Premier/Platinum/Infinite plans for 16 listed major illnesses diagnosed in India; 36-month waiting period; reimbursement only; not available on Prime plan

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies with tenure ≥1 year

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, moratorium transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India (base plans), circumcision, convalescence, external congenital anomaly, vaccination (except post-bite/child vaccination cover), home visit charges

optional_riders.display: Enhanced ReInsure (200%), ECB Safeguard, Co-payment (10/20%), Aggregate Deductible, Domestic Staff Indemnity, Accident SI top-up (2x), Wellness (gym, dietician, walk-healthy)
